primary_direction.title: Phylo-Developmental Speech Circuit Evolution Atlas
primary_direction.problem: Existing evidence separates human speech networks, primate vocalization-sensitive auditory cortex, developmental language lateralization, and speech-related temporal dynamics; it does not provide one quantitative comparison of their contributions.
primary_direction.hypothesis: Human speech evolved through exaptation and reorganization of ancient primate auditory-vocal circuitry, with human-specialized auditory-motor connectivity, precise vocal control, prolonged learning, and developmental network lateralization producing the modern speech phenotype.
mechanism: bilateral ventral speech analysis with stronger leftward dorsal specialization
developmentally emergent rather than universal lateralization
primary_direction.novelty: One preregistered atlas compares species, developmental stage, hemisphere, connectivity, and temporal coupling under matched control tasks.
primary_direction.expected_result: The integrated connection-and-development model should explain more variance in speech-learning and speech-control measures than single-region, FOXP2-only, or hemisphere-only baselines.
falsification: No relation between auditory-motor connectivity and speech-learning performance.
No speech-specific temporal coupling after non-speech and motor controls.
Single-region baseline wins under preregistered out-of-sample comparison.

portfolio.high_risk: Cross-species causal multiscale model linking genes, oscillations, and vocal learning

search_trace.evidence: Petkov et al. 2008; Rauschecker and Scott 2009
Skeide and Friederici 2016; Labache et al. 2023
Enard et al. 2002; Vargha-Khadem et al. 2005

handoff_requirements: Pre-register homologous regions and tract correspondences.
Use matched vocal, non-vocal, speech, and generic motor controls.
Model developmental age, family structure, and handedness explicitly.
Use cross-species representational alignment instead of raw activation equivalence.
Keep observed_results empty until data collection and analysis are actually performed.
